rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's or situation's predetermined fate.

example.english: I don’t know what my fate will be.
example.traditional: 我都唔知自己嘅命運會點。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 zi6 gei2 ge3 ming6 wan6 wui5 dim2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the fate is fixed and unavoidable.

example.english: He thinks this doomed relationship is fate and cannot be avoided.
example.traditional: 佢認為呢段孽緣係宿命，點避都避唔開。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jing6 wai4 ne1 dyun6 jip6 jyun4 hai6 suk1 ming6 dim2 bei6 dou1 bei6 m4 hoi1

rows.note: Use this when fate is understood specifically as the will or plan of Heaven.

example.english: The fact that we met among so many people must be fate.
example.traditional: 我哋喺咁多人入面偏偏遇到，真係天意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 jap6 min6 pin1 pin1 jyu6 dou3 zan1 hai6 tin1 ji3
